candidate: <full commit hash of the code being accepted; only records may change after it>

review.reviewer: <the milestone reviewer: tool and context, e.g. codex exec in a fresh context>
review.model: <its model: review.second_model's final_model, else its model>
review.fallback: <only when the milestone review could not use review.second_model: why; otherwise leave this field out>
review.revision: <full commit hash it reviewed (the whole milestone diff)>
review.report: <https link to the posted review report (templates/review.md)>

walkthrough.environment: <how the app ran: local build, demo data seed, browser>
walkthrough.walker: <the trial-walker agent and its context identifier>

steps.step: <the trial step, as the owner will read it>

deferred: <each item wf ci deferred to this acceptance, and every accepted_findings entry of the milestone's tasks, in plain words>
tests_changed: <each acceptance test changed in this milestone>
